comprehension.title: Story Quiz

foundation.title: Educational Foundation
foundation.content: Our reading levels are built on proven literacy research and align with Common Core State Standards, ensuring your child receives age-appropriate content that supports natural reading development.

dolch.title: Dolch Sight Word Integration
dolch.content: We use the Dolch sight word lists - the 220 most frequently used words that make up 50-75% of all reading material. By mastering these words, children can focus on comprehension rather than decoding.

progression.title: Level Progression
progression.content: Each level builds systematically: Pre-Reader (pre-literacy skills) → Beginner (Dolch Primer + Grade 1) → Developing (Grade 2-3 vocabulary) → Independent (Grade 4-5 complexity) → Advanced (Grade 6+ sophistication).

validation.title: Research-Based Framework
validation.content: Our content framework aligns with current literacy research showing that personalized, level-appropriate content increases reading engagement by up to 60%.

individual.title: Individual Pace Recognition
individual.content: We understand every child progresses differently. Our system adapts to support your child's unique learning journey without pressure or judgment, focusing on building confidence and joy in reading.

educationalApproach.title: Our Research-Based Approach
educationalApproach.encouragement: Every story is crafted to meet your child exactly where they are in their reading journey, making learning both effective and joyful.

about.title: About Time-2-Read
about.intro: Time-2-Read makes a new illustrated story for your child every time they read. The story is built around them: their name, the things they love and the reading level they are at today. It is made for children from about 3 to 15, from pre-readers who listen along to confident readers who want a challenge.
about.setup: Tell us your child's name, age and interests, and pick a reading level.
about.story: Time-2-Read writes a story with your child as the main character, with a picture on every page.
about.word: Tap any word to hear it, with phonics help for sounding out tricky words.
about.narration: Narration reads the story aloud and highlights each word as it is spoken.
about.timer: A 20-minute reading timer is built into every story.
about.plans: Your first {{count}} stories are free, with no card. Premium is {{monthly}} per month or {{annual}} per year, with a {{days}}-day free trial.
about.contact: Questions, ideas or a problem to report: write to
about.owner: Time-2-Read is built and run by {{operator}}. We take children's privacy seriously: read our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>, our <ferpa>FERPA notes for schools</ferpa> and our <accessibility>accessibility statement</accessibility>.
